head: codex/5495-publication-metadata
title: [v0.91.7][csdlc-v2][publish] Avoid stale review loop after publication metadata commit
body:
Closes #5495

Allows typed C-SDLC publication metadata commits to reconcile without a stale-review dead end while keeping substantive source and card-prose drift fail closed. Adds focused and full Rust regression proof.
